goalSummary: Unexpected cache misses for code files

facts.why: The exact function computing the SHA-256 cache signature must be identified
The runtime cache artifact file must be named as the target of invalidation troubleshooting
The file containing both _corpus_signature and its sole caller detect() must be identified
Relationship: content-classified files hash path+mtime_ns+size, while path-deterministic files hash only path, explaining differing cache-miss behavior
The expensive classification pass duration that the cache avoids must be documented
Fix: excluding large binary/Office files via .graphifyignore avoids unnecessary content classification overhead
